exposure: Prior contraceptive counseling during Antenatal care
outcome: Contraceptive uptake in the immediate postpartum period
cohort: Women aged 18-49 years who delivered at Kawempe Hospital and were discharged within 72 hours after delivery
finding: Contraceptive uptake in the immediate postpartum period was low (15.4%) and independently associated with grand multiparity, cesarean delivery, and prior contraceptive counseling during antenatal care.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was independently associated with immediate postpartum contraceptive uptake.
